title: Troponin
what: This is a blood test from a vein. It shows whether the heart muscle is damaged.
why: Usually in an emergency, for chest pain or a possible heart attack. Sometimes for follow-up after heart problems.
duration: the blood draw takes a few minutes; in hospital, results usually come within an hour; the test is often repeated after 1 to 3 hours
tell_doctor: When the chest pain started and what it feels like
What heart and blood pressure medicines you take
If you recently did very hard exercise

prepare.title: Prep
prepare.text: None needed. With chest pain, do not wait. The test is done right away in hospital.

prepare.title: Important
prepare.text: If you have chest pain, do not go to a lab on your own. Call emergency services.

bring: Past ECGs, if you have them
steps: A nurse takes blood from a vein, often placing an IV line at the same time
An ECG is usually done at the same time
Blood is often taken again after 1 to 3 hours
The doctor compares the two results
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
after: Your doctor will decide on further tests and treatment
If the test was planned, results usually come the same day
red_flags: Pain, pressure, or burning in the chest for more than a few minutes: call emergency services
Pain spreading to the arm, jaw, or back, with cold sweat or shortness of breath: call emergency services

faq.a: It rises gradually. The second test shows whether the level is changing.

faq.q: Can I just get a troponin test at a lab if I have chest pain?
faq.a: No. With chest pain, call emergency services. An ECG and fast care matter most.

reminders.text: Planned troponin test tomorrow. No prep needed. If you get chest pain, call emergency services right away.
